hypothesis: Combination therapy of PD-1 blockade and CTLA-4 blockade will enhance anti-tumor immune response
prediction: Increased overall survival rate in melanoma patients
units_range: percentage of patients showing overall survival at 2 years
falsification_condition: If the combination therapy does not show a statistically significant increase in overall survival rate compared to monotherapy with either PD-1 or CTLA-4 blockade alone (p-value > 0.05)
